newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Kohl, Russian PM discuss Yeltsin's planned surgery.
newsitem.headline: Kohl, Russian PM discuss Yeltsin's planned surgery.

text.p: German Chancellor Helmut Kohl and Russian Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin discussed President Boris Yeltsin's planned heart operation by telephone on Monday, Interfax news agency said.
Interfax quoted a source close to Chernomyrdin as saying the two leaders had talked for about 40 minutes.
The agency said Chernomyrdin had told Kohl that Yeltsin planned to continue working while he prepares for surgery at the Barvikha sanatorium on the edge of Moscow.

Chernomyrdin, who has already taken on some of Yeltsin's duties and will temporarily assume all presidential functions when Yeltsin has the operation, confirmed Russia's readiness to use the services of two German doctors as advisers.
A group of Russian surgeons is due to fly to Germany this week for consultations with German experts, Interfax said.

Yeltsin, who moved to Barvikha at the weekend after three weeks in hospital, is expected to have a heart bypass operation in the next two months. He has been working for up to three hours a day in hospital, aides say.
Kohl enjoys good personal relations with Yeltsin and visited the Kremlin leader while he was on vacation outside Moscow a month ago, soon after Yeltisn announced he would have the surgery.
